ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 0.55:0.45 ratio of low-intensity (dark) central pixels to high-intensity (white) lateral lobe pixels, creating a high-contrast bi-tonal distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity zone forming a broad V-shape from the peduncle to the median notch; lateral high-intensity white zones covering the majority of the fluke surface; dark pixel clusters observed at the extreme distal tips and along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees; depth extends approximately 12% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations observed across the entire trailing edge; irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 2-8 pixels in depth relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature on the trailing edge transitioning to sharp, upward-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters (3-5 pixels in diameter) concentrated on the distal-right white lobe surface, indicative of sessile organism attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Evidence of significant edge wear and irregular tissue loss along the upper trailing margins of both lobes, creating a non-uniform, jagged profile.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vertical dark pigmentation streak located on the interior left lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the central notch to the tip.
